expanded.text: “GPC choice-enforcement risk observed”: Global Privacy Control (GPC) was verified in the page request and browser setting. Samples include 35 tracking requests; 32 collected data. “Non-discrimination disclosure not found in the inspected policy”: A complete inspection of retained English policy text and material linked supplements found no consumer-rights disclosure for non-discrimination when exercising privacy rights. This is a scoped disclosure finding, assessed assuming CCPA/CPRA applies; it does not prove requests would be refused. “Low text contrast”: Low-contrast text was detected on 1 tested page (6 element failures). Retained examples measured 3.3:1 (required 4.5:1); 3.19:1 (required 4.5:1); 3.9:1 (required 4.5:1). Check that GPC sets the sale/sharing opt-out and controls advertising collection.
